class.name: PlayFabPartyTextMessageConfig
class.brief_description: Per-message options for [method PlayFabPartyChat.send_text_async] and [method PlayFabPartyChatControl.send_text_async].
class.description:
Title-supplied metadata attached when the addon forwards a text message through the local Party chat control.
PlayFab Party has no per-message language or translation setting. The sender's language comes from [method PlayFabPartyChat.set_language_async] on the local chat control, and translation is a receiver-side setting applied with [method PlayFabPartyChat.set_text_chat_options_async].

members.member: Title-supplied metadata attached to the message. Serialized into a single Party data buffer and delivered verbatim to receivers as [member PlayFabPartyChatMessage.metadata]. Decoded on the receiving side with object instantiation disabled, so only plain Variant data survives the round trip.
